_comment: Display-name and note overrides applied on top of UNHCR/WPP names (spec §11.3, §11.5). Keys are canonical ISO3 / pseudo codes. `name_source` records whose naming the raw `name` follows.

SRB.note: UNHCR reports Serbia and Kosovo together under "Serbia and Kosovo: S/RES/1244 (1999)"; figures shown here for Serbia include Kosovo.
SRB.note_zh: UNHCR 將塞爾維亞與科索沃合併報告為「Serbia and Kosovo: S/RES/1244 (1999)」;此處塞爾維亞數字含科索沃。

XKX.note: Not reported separately by UNHCR (included in Serbia). Boundary from Natural Earth; population from UN WPP.
XKX.note_zh: UNHCR 未單獨報告(併入塞爾維亞)。邊界取自 Natural Earth;人口取自 UN WPP。

TWN.note: Not listed in UNHCR statistics (no figures, not merged into any other entry). Boundary from Natural Earth; population from UN WPP (listed there as "China, Taiwan Province of China").
TWN.note_zh: UNHCR 統計中不存在（無數字，亦未併入其他條目）。邊界取自 Natural Earth；人口取自 UN WPP（該處名稱為「China, Taiwan Province of China」）。
TWN._pending: Display policy (c) implemented by default; awaiting client confirmation (spec §11.5 / Appendix C).

PSE.note: UNHCR figures exclude Palestine refugees registered with UNRWA (~6 million), who are counted by UNRWA separately.
PSE.note_zh: UNHCR 數字不含 UNRWA 登記之巴勒斯坦難民(約 600 萬),UNRWA 另行統計。

ESH.note: Non-self-governing territory; shown as in Natural Earth. UNHCR reports figures under "Western Sahara".
ESH.note_zh: 非自治領土;依 Natural Earth 呈現。UNHCR 以「Western Sahara」報告。

SYR.note: UNHCR figures exclude Palestine refugees registered with UNRWA in Syria (~0.6 million), counted by UNRWA separately.
SYR.note_zh: UNHCR 數字不含在敘利亞向 UNRWA 登記的巴勒斯坦難民（約 60 萬），UNRWA 另行統計。

JOR.note: UNHCR figures exclude Palestine refugees registered with UNRWA in Jordan (~2.4 million), counted by UNRWA separately.
JOR.note_zh: UNHCR 數字不含在約旦向 UNRWA 登記的巴勒斯坦難民（約 240 萬），UNRWA 另行統計。

LBN.note: UNHCR figures exclude Palestine refugees registered with UNRWA in Lebanon (~0.5 million), counted by UNRWA separately.
LBN.note_zh: UNHCR 數字不含在黎巴嫩向 UNRWA 登記的巴勒斯坦難民（約 50 萬），UNRWA 另行統計。

XXA.note: UNHCR pseudo-entity used as country of origin for stateless persons.
XXA.note_zh: UNHCR 用於無國籍者來源國之虛擬條目。

UNK.note: UNHCR pseudo-entity for unknown or unspecified origin.
UNK.note_zh: UNHCR 用於來源不明或未指明之虛擬條目。

TIB.note: UNHCR origin entity "Tibetan"; not a country and not drawn on the map.
TIB.note_zh: UNHCR 來源條目「Tibetan」;非國家,不繪於地圖。

CRB.note: UNHCR aggregate entity; not drawn on the map.
CRB.note_zh: UNHCR 彙總條目;不繪於地圖。

AB9.note: IDMC reports Abyei Area separately; not drawn on the map.
AB9.note_zh: IDMC 單獨報告阿卜耶伊地區;不繪於地圖。

OTH.note: Small entities whose code could not be matched to a country; see unmatched-report.json.
OTH.note_zh: 無法匹配國家代碼之小型條目;見 unmatched-report.json。
